steps.label: fluid
steps.run: cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/esp/"* . && RES=180 FLCACHE="$AGENT_HOME/work/flcache_esp4" /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P fltest.py > bl.log 2>&1; grep -a 'FLTEST DONE' bl.log | cut -c1-900 || true; tail -30 bl.log > bltail.txt; a="bltail.txt esp/fl4/bltail.txt fl.json esp/fl4/fl.json"; for f in fl/*.jpg; do a="$a $f esp/fl4/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2; du -sh "$AGENT_HOME/work/flcache_esp"
